name: Henrique Sá Pessoa
address: Travessa da Légua De Póvoa 11, Corpo 3, Bloco B, Loja L - Páteo Bagatela, 1250-138, Lisbon
dinnerNote: Clássicos or Costa a Costa tasting menu (Encontros menu €160)
dinnerNotePt: Menu de degustação Clássicos ou Costa a Costa (menu Encontros 160 €)
lunchNote: Encontros menu; the tasting menus are served at lunch too · Thu–Sat
lunchNotePt: Menu Encontros; os menus de degustação também são servidos ao almoço · qui.–sáb.

menus.name: Clássicos tasting menu
menus.note: Signature dishes; lunch or dinner, not for bookings from 1:15pm or 9:15pm; the whole table takes it

menus.name: Costa a Costa tasting menu
menus.note: Portuguese fish and seafood; lunch or dinner, not for bookings from 1:15pm or 9:15pm; the whole table takes it

menus.name: Encontros menu
menus.note: Shorter menu with a choice at each course; lunch or dinner; the whole table takes it

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, which asks for a card to hold the booking, or by email to reservas@henriquesapessoa.com.
cancellation: Free to cancel or change up to 48 hours before. Later cancellations, and no-shows after the 15 minutes' grace, are charged €140 a person (VAT included) to the card given when booking.
groups: A private room looking onto the kitchen; book it by email to reservas@henriquesapessoa.com.
dressCode: Smart casual. No sportswear or flip-flops.
children: Children aged 10 and over are welcome.
duration: SevenRooms allows three and a half hours for a table of two.
